z-m-17-03.title: Ukuzalisa isitya esinesimo sesifere, sifuna amanzi esitya esinesimo sekhoni amaxesha amangaphi?
z-m-17-03.topic: Umthamo wesifere: ubudlelwane phakathi kwemithamo yesifere, ikhoni, nesilinda
z-m-17-03.goal: Qikelela ubudlelwane phakathi kwemithamo yesifere, ikhoni, nesilinda phambi kokubala, hlaziya uqikelelo ngalo lonke ixesha isiphumo sokulinganisa sifika uze usihlele ube ngumlinganiselo ochanekileyo, uze ulinganise ukuba umthamo uba nkulu kangakanani xa ubude buphindwa kabini.
z-m-17-03.material: Kukho isitya A esinesimo sesifere esine-radius ye-3 cm, isitya B esinesimo sekhoni esine-radius yesiseko ye-3 cm nobude be-6 cm, nesitya C esinesimo sesilinda esine-radius yesiseko ye-3 cm nobude be-6 cm. Isifere A singena ngaphakathi kwesilinda C sichukumisa phezulu, ezantsi, necala kanye. Masithi ubukhulu bezitya awuqwalaselwa kwaye akukho manzi ahlulukayo. Ubungakanani bezitya buxelwa kwakhona kwinyathelo ngalinye lalo msebenzi.
z-m-17-03.thinking.0: Ukwahlula oko kuqinisekileyo koko kuqikelelwa ngoko ukwaziyo ngoku
z-m-17-03.thinking.2: Ukunonophela xa wenza ngokubanzi ngokulinganisa okunye

z-m-17-03.prereq.1: Akufuneki wazi ifomula yomthamo wesifere (ifumaneka kulo msebenzi)
z-m-17-03.s.s1.prompt: Idatha iyavezwa icandelo linye ngexesha. Kwinyathelo ngalinye, khetha oko ucinga kufanelekile kakhulu ngoko kwaziwayo ngoku, kwaye xa idatha entsha ifika, qhubeka okanye uhlaziye isigwebo sakho.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.hint.0: Kwinyathelo ngalinye, wahlula oko unokukuthetha ngokuqinisekileyo ngoko kwaziwayo ukuza kuthi ga ngoku koko kuqikelelwa nje.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.hint.1: Uthatha isilinda C njengereferensi, zoba okanye ucinge amacandelo athathwa sisifere A kunye nekhoni B, uze uwathelekise.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Zikho izitya ezintathu. A sisifere esine-radius ye-3 cm, B yikhoni enesiseko se-radius ye-3 cm nobude be-6 cm, kwaye C sisilinda esinesiseko se-radius ye-3 cm nobude be-6 cm. Isifere A singena ngaphakathi kwesilinda C sichukumisa phezulu, ezantsi, necala kanye. Ubukhulu bezitya abuqwalaselwa kwaye akukho manzi ahlulukayo. Umthamo wekhoni enesiseko nobude obufanayo yisithathu somthamo wesilinda.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Uzama ukugcwalisa A ngokupheleleyo ngokugcwalisa B ngamanzi uwatshele kwi-A, uphinda. Phambi kokubala, ucinga ukuba zingaphi izihlandlo zokutshela ezifunekayo ukuze A igcwale?
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Isifere A singena ngaphakathi kwesilinda C kwaye kukho indawo engenanto kufutshane neekona, ngoko unokuthi kuthatha ngaphantsi kwamaxesha ama-3 e-B, isixa esigcwalisa i-C. Awukwazi ukwazi kanye ukuba zingaphi izihlandlo okwangoku.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Kubonakala A iya kugcwala emva kokutshela malunga namaxesha ama-3, ngaphandle kokunqongophala
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ucinge ukuba isifere sizalisa isilinda ngokupheleleyo. Cinga ngeendawo ezingenanto phakathi kwesifere neekona zesilinda.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Kubonakala kuyanela ukutshela ngaphezulu kwexesha eli-1 nangaphantsi kwamaxesha ama-3
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Uqikelele ukuba ngaphezulu kwesitya esinye sekhoni kodwa ayingako njengesilinda. Thetha ukuba yintoni uthelekiso oluxhasa oku.

z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Ngokulinganisa, A ingamaxesha ama-2 e-B kwaye isilinda C singamaxesha ama-3 e-B. Ngoko A ngamabini kwamathathu e-C. Ungajonga nangokubala. B yi-18π, A yi-36π, kwaye C yi-54π cm³. Kodwa ke, ukuthi ukulinganisa kunye kusebenza kuzo zonke ubungakanani, ufuna ukujonga nakwezinye ubungakanani.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: A ingamaxesha ama-2 e-B kwaye C ingamaxesha ama-3 e-B, ngoko A ngamabini kwamathathu e-C
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Udibanise isiphumo sokulinganisa nobudlelwane phakathi kwesilinda nekhoni waza wafunda nobudlelwane phakathi kwesifere nesilinda.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: A yisiqingatha se-C, kuba isifere singena kwisilinda kanye
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Uve ukuba ekubeni isifere singena kwisilinda kanye, siya kuba siqingatha. Thelekisa nenyani yokuba kulinganiso A ingamaxesha ama-2 e-B kwaye C ingamaxesha ama-3 e-B.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Singazi kuphela ukuba A ingamaxesha ama-2 e-B kwaye asinakwazi ubudlelwane ne-C
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Awusebenzisanga ubudlelwane phakathi kwesilinda nekhoni obunikiweyo kunye nokulinganisa. Dibanisa iinyani ezimbini.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Silinganise ityala elinye kuphela, ngoko kufuneka sijonge ngokwahlukileyo ukuba kuyafana kwezinye ubungakanani
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Esi sisimo sengqondo esinononophelo ekwenzeni ngokubanzi ngokulinganisa okunye. Kunye nalo mgwebo, unokuchaza nobudlelwane obufumeneyo ngoku.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Ngoku senza izitya ezinobude bonke buphindwe kabini. A' sisifere esine-radius ye-6 cm, kwaye C' sisilinda esinesiseko se-radius ye-6 cm nobude be-12 cm. A' nayo singena kanye ngaphakathi kwe-C'.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Umthamo wa-A′ ungamaxesha amangaphi umthamo ka-A?
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Umthamo wesilinda C' yi-π×6²×12 = 432π, onamaxesha ama-8 e-54π ye-C. A' ngamabini kwamathathu e-C', ngoko 288π, kwaye A yi-36π, ngoko ngamaxesha ama-8. Xa ubude buphindwa kabini, ububanzi, ubunzulu, nobude zonke ziphindwa kabini, ngoko umthamo uba ngamaxesha angama-2×2×2 = 8.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ucinge ukuba xa ubude buphindwa kabini, umthamo uphindwa kabini nawo. Thelekisa imithamo yezilinda C' kunye no-C ngqo.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Eli lixabiso lokuphindaphinda u-2 kabini, njengendawo. Kumthamo, zonke iindlela ezintathu, ububanzi, ubunzulu, nobude, ziyabandakanyeka.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Oku kuqwalasele ukuba zonke iindlela ezintathu ziphindwa kabini.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Eli lixabiso lokuphindaphinda u-2 amaxesha amane. Jonga ukuba ufuna ukuphindaphinda iindlela ezingaphi.
z-m-17-03.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni wawunokuthi uluhlu 'ngaphantsi kwamaxesha ama-3,' ngokulinganisa wafunda ubudlelwane 2 : 3, kwaye ekugqibeleni walinganisa ukuba umthamo uba ngamaxesha amangaphi xa ubude bandiswa. Jonga umva ukuba kukuqiniseka phi okukhule okanye kwancipha kwinyathelo ngalinye nokuba bubuphi ubungqina obubangele oko.

z-m-17-03.s.s2.hint.0: Ukusuka kwiziphumo zokulinganisa, bhala umgca omnye ngamnye wobudlelwane be-A, B, no-C ngokwe 'maxesha amangaphi.'

z-m-17-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ngaba ubhale ngokucacileyo isibhengezo esilungisiweyo (umzekelo, iqhezu) ngamanani?
z-m-17-03.s.s2.model.0: Akulunganga. Ukutshela B amaxesha ama-2 kuzalisa A, kwaye C ithatha amaxesha ama-3 e-B, ngoko A ngamabini kwamathathu e-C. Kulungile ukuba isifere sincinci kunesilinda, kodwa singaphezulu kakhulu kunesiqingatha.
z-m-17-03.s.s2.model.1: A yi-36π kwaye C yi-54π cm³, ngoko A÷C = 2/3. Nangona isifere singena kanye kwisilinda, iikona azinanto, ngoko asizalisi, kodwa sizalisa ngamabini kwamathathu, hayi isiqingatha. Uqikelelo luka-Sua lufuna ukulungiswa.

z-m-17-02.material:
Ebusweni bewotshi ye-analog, amanani ali-12 abekwe ngezithuba ezilinganayo, kwaye iingile zilinganiswa ngokuhamba ngewotshi ukusuka kwicala le-12 o'clock. Iwotshi ichanekile kwaye ingalo nganye iguquka ngesantya esingatshintshiyo. Ingalo yeeyure iguquka kanye ngeeyure ezili-12, kwaye ingalo yemizuzu iguquka kanye ngemizuzu engama-60. U-Minjae wazama ukufumana ingile eyenziwe yingalo yeeyure neyemizuzu ngentsimbi ye-3:20 (encinci kwezimbini) waza wayisombulula njengoko kubonisiwe ngezantsi.
1) Ukujikeleza kanye kwewotshi yi-360° kwaye kukho amanani ali-12, ngoko isithuba esinye senani yi-30°.
2) Ingalo yemizuzu iguquka kanye ngemizuzu engama-60, ngoko iya kwi-6° ngomzuzu, kwaye kwimizuzu engama-20 ikwi-120° ukusuka kwicala le-12 o'clock.
3) Ingalo yeeyure ikhomba kwi-3, ngoko ikwi-90° ukusuka kwicala le-12 o'clock.
4) Ingile phakathi kweengalo ezimbini yi-120° − 90° = 30°.
5) Ngoko ingile eyenziwe yingalo yeeyure neyemizuzu ngentsimbi ye-3:20 yi-30°.
